import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

const WORKSPACE_AUDIT_CONFIG = /^["']?auditConfig["']?\s*:/m;

describe('audit config detector', () => {
  it('matches a quoted key', () => {
    expect(WORKSPACE_AUDIT_CONFIG.test('"auditConfig":')).toBe(true);
  });

  it('still catches a real violation after the regex', () => {
    const url = new URL('file:///Users/example/after-regex.js');
    expect(url.protocol).toBe('file:');
  });
});
